name: Khoj
description: Self-hosted AI second brain. A personal RAG assistant that lets you chat with your notes, documents, and the web using local or cloud LLMs.

env.label: Django Secret Key
env.description: Secret key used by the Khoj Django backend to sign sessions and tokens

env.label: Database User
env.description: PostgreSQL username for the Khoj database

env.label: Database Password
env.description: Password for the Khoj PostgreSQL (pgvector) database

env.label: Database Name
env.description: Name of the Khoj PostgreSQL database

env.label: Admin Email
env.description: Email address for the Khoj admin account used to log into the web UI

env.label: Admin Password
env.description: Password for the Khoj admin account used to log into the web UI

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: Optional; or configure a local/Ollama model in the UI
